concerns.text: T011c (Classification Logic) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T015a (Download ALL). The task description states it runs 'AFTER download is complete', implying a strict sequential dependency. If T011c is executed in parallel with T015a, it will fail due to missing input data. The [P] tag is incorrect for this task.

T025c (Bootstrap Resampling) is marked [P] but depends on T025b (Compute Censored Kendall's Tau). The bootstrap process requires the initial tau calculation or the underlying data structure established by T025b. Executing T025c in parallel with T025b violates the producer-consumer dependency.

T030a (Output Correlation Stats) is marked [P] but depends on T025b and T025c. It consumes the results of the bootstrap and correlation tasks. Marking it [P] suggests it can run concurrently with its producers, which is a semantic ordering violation.

T030d (Aggregate Stats) is marked [P] but depends on T030a, T030b, T030c, and T026. It is a consumer of multiple prior tasks. The [P] tag is invalid as it cannot proceed until all its inputs are generated.

T049 (Quantitative Evidence Summary) is marked [P] but depends on T045, T046, T047, T034, and T026. It aggregates results from multiple review-response tasks. It cannot be parallel-safe with its dependencies.

T053 (Create Pipeline Orchestrator) is marked [P] but depends on T012, T020, and T027. The orchestrator must import and execute modules that are defined in these tasks. It cannot be parallel-safe with the implementation of the modules it orchestrates.
